faqs: Will my WhatsApp number get blocked?

Using the official WhatsApp Business Platform with approved templates and opted-in contacts keeps you within WhatsApp's rules. Most blocks come from bulk messaging people who never opted in from a regular WhatsApp app, which we don't do.
Can I keep using my existing business number?

Usually yes, but a number moved to the WhatsApp Business Platform can no longer be used in the regular WhatsApp app at the same time. We help you decide whether to move your current number or use a new one.
What does WhatsApp charge for messages?

WhatsApp charges per message for some template messages, and the rates change from time to time. Replies within 24 hours of a customer messaging you are treated differently. We explain the current pricing for your volume before you start.
Can it connect to my Facebook lead ads?
Yes. New Meta lead form submissions can trigger an instant WhatsApp message and land in your CRM or Google Sheet at the same time.
Do I still need a sales team?
Yes. Automation handles the first reply, reminders and routing so your team spends its time on people who are ready to talk.
